name: weighted exercise ball wall squat
description: A wall squat with a stability ball behind you while holding extra weight. It adds load to a back-supported squat.
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Hold your weight at chest level or at your sides.
Step your feet forward and squat as the ball rolls down your back.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to rise back up.
